page.content:
Burning range that only Princess Iron Fan's palm-leaf fan can cool.

How Flaming Mountains connects

  • Character: Princess Iron Fan — Only Iron Fan's palm-leaf fan can quench the Flaming Mountains.
  • Event: Eighty-one tribulations — Crossing the Flaming Mountains is one of the numbered ordeals.

What is Flaming Mountains?

The Flaming Mountains block the pilgrims in the novel's middle west. Wukong must borrow the Banana-Leaf Fan from Iron Fan and outwit the Bull Demon King to cross.

Key threads lead to Princess Iron Fan and Eighty-one tribulations.
